name: Lofepramine
contraindications: Concurrent MAO inhibitor use and other standard TCA contraindications; known hypersensitivity
interactions: Interactions similar to other tricyclic antidepressants — caution with other serotonergic agents and MAOIs
monitoring: Monitor for clinical response, anticholinergic side effects and cardiac symptoms; ECG in older patients or those with cardiac risk
pregnancy: Use only if benefits outweigh risks and under specialist advice
sideEffects: Anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, constipation), orthostatic hypotension; lower cardiotoxicity in overdose compared with older TCAs
clinicalPearls: Considered safer than many TCAs in overdose; useful option when TCA is clinically indicated, especially in older patients
indication: Major depressive disorder when a tricyclic antidepressant is indicated
